Fixture SD Foundation Community Scholarship

The Fixture SD Foundation Community Scholarship supports graduating high school seniors from San Diego County who plan to pursue a college degree in a STEM field.

Eligibility

Open to current 12th grade students who are residents of San Diego County and have been accepted to an accredited two- or four-year college or university for the upcoming academic year.

Program Dates

Applications open on November 1, 2026 and are due by January 15, 2027.

Award

Selected recipients receive a $5,000 scholarship toward tuition.

How to Apply

Submit the online application along with a personal statement and one letter of recommendation. Decisions are announced by March 1, 2027.
